report.summary: Patient P-D006 (age 59, uninsured/self-pay, no transport benefit) was seen at visit V-D006. Two needs identified: med_cost and transport. Key findings: tiotropium brand inhaler copay $420/month with a 45-day refill gap; albuterol $30/mo with 10-day gap; amlodipine $4/mo. Social screener indicates transportation need ("no") and living situation worry. Home tract 17031290900: 41.2% of households have no vehicle, 36 transit stops within 800 m, 29 early-morning stops, and the area is low-income (low-income/low-access flag = 1.0). Upcoming primary-care appointment appt:2 on 2026-10-23 at 14:00 at the Clinic; transit feasibility could not be checked because no facility location is on file for that appointment.
